answer: The voyage starts with one work slot: lock a 70-credit deposit and pay 40. Each epoch the deposit burns 7 toward its nadir unless the slot's task is done. A done task earns an umber seal in the public ledger; an auditor replays it. A forged or rented seal burns the deposit and voids the identity. 1,000 fakes cost 1,000×110=110,000 against a 40,000 pool: a 70,000 loss. An honest agent pays 40 once, does its task, and keeps deposit and share.
